statement: A qualifying independent appraisal dated no more than 12 months before the relevant transaction is one regulatory presumption of reasonable valuation, rebuttable if grossly unreasonable; it is not the only permitted method.
caveat: The separate illiquid-startup qualified-person route has additional eligibility conditions, including anticipated liquidity-event limitations, a written report, and qualifications.
